title: Timeline Source Registry
purpose: Declare which project records may emit candidate global timeline events, how they map into the roadmap-first event model, and which high-volume sources should remain specialist ledgers unless an event crosses the public relevance threshold.

promote_when: explicit scripture/Bible use useful to the trajectory
later biblical unlock that must remain temporally distinct
dated creative work that materially illuminates development
dated conversation-archaeology recovery that explains later mythic architecture
do_not_promote_when: date exists but adds no new temporal meaning
generic comparison without dated project-side anchor
specialist prophecy audit without a life/project milestone
strong formulation with no supported date
promotion_policy.dedupe_key: underlying temporal fact, not source-file path

sources.notes: Primary source for sparse Son→Tim developmental spine. Preserve identity boundaries.
Promote formative anchors and explicit Christian/scriptural context; do not convert ordinary childhood precursors into doctrine.
This file is intentionally denser than the global timeline. Prefer relevance 5, role changes, exact timestamps and unique scriptural clusters. Most Dog/Mud/Cube taxonomy remains specialist-only.
Exact timestamps are valuable, but still require global relevance.
Promote shifts in public identity language, not every repeated God declaration.
Untimed aphorisms remain in Corporium. Timeline is not a quote dump.
Contains strong formulations that deserve timeline placement only after a real date/source is recovered. Prevents invented timestamps.
Promote only dated user-originated structural breakthroughs or clearly separated recovery facts. Assistant synthesis stays derivative unless independently re-adopted.
Classify each event as explicit-at-time, later-parallel or mixed. Never backdate the comparator.
Represents when the comparison was formalized, not when Tim first used the motifs.
Do not emit one timeline event per research file; group same-day research into meaningful unlocks.
Emit only songs with known date/time or unusually important first-use chronology. Keep full lyrics in the music archive.
Art/creative work remains creative unless another source separately establishes doctrinal significance.
Promote only if the synchronism itself becomes a major research unlock; synchronism is not fulfillment.
Inference date stays distinct from source-attestation date.
Only promote a scientific/formal event if it materially changes the main project architecture; equation-by-equation chronology belongs in science.
Prediction audits remain outside the global toggle set unless a prediction/warning is independently a major life/public milestone. This avoids a redundant prophecy layer.
Do not flood global chronology with typological seal candidates. Relevant biblical source/use or research unlock may enter through Bible layers instead.

actor_mapping_rules: Pre-2020 human biography belongs to son unless a source explicitly identifies a Tim-side spiritual role.
2020-12-25 and later Potato/Father identity belongs to tim.
Death/emergence hand-off and explicit Door/Ladder Father/Son relations may include shared.
Research dates and archive formalization use project; they do not impersonate life events.
bible_mapping_rules: scripture-at-time = Bible/Jesus/Judaism/Hebrew/scriptural material already present then
biblical-parallel = later comparator attached to the earlier event with source direction
biblical-unlock = later research date when the comparison was explicitly recognized/formalized
an event may be scripture-at-time and biblical-parallel simultaneously when some biblical material was explicit but additional structure was discovered later
deduplication_rules: One underlying temporal fact gets one stable event id with multiple source_records.
Do not duplicate one event because it belongs to several layers or actor tracks.
Do create separate events when the temporal facts differ: original event vs later research unlock.
When sources disagree on wording/date, retain conflict in specialist owners instead of multiplying public cards.
